$doc: Map generation. The generator is art-agnostic: it lays out a grid of room SLOTS, then asks the active art pack for blueprints that fit each slot's footprint + door mask. See docs/systems/GENERATION.md.

layout.$multiCell: Larger rooms are packed into the grid BEFORE the spanning tree, and each multi-cell blueprint is used at most once per map. `maxSlots` caps how many are packed at all; `footprintWeights` is the order they are tried in, so a 2x1 gets a look in long before an L. Set `enabled: false` to fall back to a grid of 1x1 rooms.

containers.$doc: Player-side interaction timings. Opening a chest is deliberately slow and loud - see player.json -> noise.chestOpen.

contents.$doc: Per-room content budgets. The generator picks a count in [min,max] then fills the blueprint's declared anchors.

loot.$doc: Weighted tables. Ids resolve against config/items.json; `empty` leaves the slot bare. The mandatory keys are placed separately and override whatever these rolled - see doors.lockedDoorCount / keySpareCount.
loot.$note: Only `key` has a behaviour and a model so far. medicine / brick / coin / flashGrenade / barricade come back into these tables with plan step 37.

validation.$doc: Generator post-checks. Failing any check re-rolls up to maxAttempts, then falls back to a guaranteed-solvable layout.
